findings.notes: Controller-issued HMAC provenance binds persisted target and policy UIDs to generation routing metadata. Non-trigger admission, clone-source traversal, policy reconciliation, and cleanup reject unsigned or forged candidates; queued requests retain policy identity and cleanup uses UID/resourceVersion preconditions. User-owned clone-source restores and standalone managed-by labels remain compatible. Preserve the installation key across upgrades; unsigned older downstreams require a trusted trigger event or explicit generateExisting re-evaluation. This records the unreleased release-1.19-n4k fix for the 1.19.2 security workstream; no patched enterprise tag or public release is asserted. Hold public docs until advisory disclosure.
